### Data Read (6)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve details for a specific item by its ID.
- `GET /consumeroffers/notifications/uk` — Retrieve consumer offer notifications in the UK.
- `GET /consumers/uk/stampcards/status/{statuId}/restaurant` — Check the status of a restaurant stamp card in the UK.
- `GET /geocode/uk/reverse` — Reverse geocode a location in the UK.
- `GET /restaurant/uk/{ukId}/menu/dynamic` — Get the dynamic menu for a UK restaurant.
- `GET /web/{webId}` — Retrieve web data by ID.

### Data Write (2)
